overview: Students and instructors at Medford Vocational Technical High School describe the educational experience, career opportunities, and collaborative environment of the carpentry shop.

items.title: Carpentry Shop Profile
items.summary: Participants detailed the hands-on curriculum of the carpentry program, emphasizing the importance of teamwork, the shop's welcoming atmosphere, and the long-term potential for graduates to run their own businesses.

subject: Vocational Technical High School Carpentry Shop Profile
